path.title: Lakehouse storage
path.summary: Files, pruning and table snapshots without format confusion.

lessons.title: Files, partitions and pruning
lessons.summary: Understand physical storage before adding a new table format.

blocks.title: The mental model
blocks.body: The diagram is a conceptual storage tree. The Try query groups the local seed only; it does not measure Parquet pruning. Actual pruning and file checks remain in Lakehouse Lab.

blocks.title: Common mistake
blocks.body: Calling a logical SQL GROUP BY a physical partitioning operation, or treating an illustrated grey file as measured pruning.

blocks.title: Before you run
blocks.body: Where would you expect a predicate on year to eliminate work: table, file or row group?

blocks.title: Changing a partition scheme
blocks.body: The linked concept check compares partition evolution across table formats. It is a no-execution question; use Lakehouse Lab for the existing real-file partitioning and pruning missions. Changing metadata does not imply that every historical file was rewritten.

code.source:
SELECT segment_id, COUNT(*) AS rows_in_segment
FROM source.orders GROUP BY segment_id ORDER BY segment_id;

visual.title: Files, partitions and pruning - visual walkthrough

steps.title: A table spans files
steps.body: Several Parquet files can make up one logical table.

steps.title: Partition directories
steps.body: Directory values can eliminate entire partitions for compatible predicates.

steps.title: Row groups
steps.body: Min/max statistics may let the reader skip row groups; this is not an index.

steps.title: Verify on real files
steps.body: Open Lakehouse Lab and use the pruning mission. This visual does not inspect your files.

lessons.title: Snapshots: Delta, DuckLake and Iceberg
lessons.summary: Keep file formats, table metadata and retention separate.

blocks.title: The mental model
blocks.body: Mosaic already has real local DuckLake and bounded Delta missions. Iceberg is a concept here, not an implemented connector. The visual does not manufacture manifests or transaction logs.

blocks.title: Common mistake
blocks.body: Promising time travel after all historic files have been removed, or treating Delta and Iceberg as alternative Parquet encodings.

blocks.title: Before you run
blocks.body: Why is keeping only the transaction log insufficient for time travel?

visual.title: Snapshots: Delta, DuckLake and Iceberg - visual walkthrough

steps.title: Parquet is data
steps.body: Parquet stores columnar data, not a complete transaction history.

steps.title: Metadata selects files
steps.body: A table format describes which data files belong to a table version.

steps.title: Time travel
steps.body: A historical query needs both the metadata and referenced data files.

steps.title: Retention matters
steps.body: Deleting old files can make old versions unreadable.
